plain_english: Thus, as far as this has been stated — direct for someone's attainment-of-release; as-stated-summary-manner it holds for someone, from the application's coming in the to-be-told initiation; so initiation-and-rest is to be told.
sanskrit_cite: tatra yāvat idam uktam tat sākṣāt kasyacit apavargāptaye yathoktasaṃgrahanītyā bhavati kasyacit vakṣyamāṇadīkṣāyām upayogagamanāt iti dīkṣādikaṃ vaktavyam

plain_english: Therein: who is qualified? — for that determination the power-descent is examined.
sanskrit_cite: tatra kaḥ adhikārī iti nirūpaṇārthaṃ śaktipāto vicāryate

plain_english: Therein some say: from absence of knowledge, saṃsāra rooted in ignorance; from its departure's knowledge-arising, power-descent. To them: knowledge-arising alone is distorted — to be said. If act-produced, [it behaves] like act-fruit; in enjoyment-ness, in the enjoymenter too — the two possibilities of power-descent are excessive consequence. In being-caused-by-the-Lord's-will, however: knowledge-arising's mutual-dependence and futility; in the Lord, passion-and-rest-issue. Of two contradictory acts of equal force, mutual-obstruction: act-equivalence — then power-descent? No: in being-sequential, from impossibility-of-contradiction; even in contradiction, of the uncontradicted act's enjoyment-giving issue — in non-contradicted act's non-occurrence, just-then body-death issue: birth-and-lifespan-giving act is not obstructed; enjoyment-giving is. If asked why: in that-act's-presence, if power might-fall, then she — of the enjoyment-giver — why would she fear?
sanskrit_cite: tatra kecit āhuḥ jñānābhāvāt ajñānamūlaḥ saṃsāraḥ tadapagame jñānodayāt śaktipāta iti teṣāṃ samyak jñānodaya eva vikṛta iti vācyam karmajanyatve karmaphalavat bhogatvaprasaṅge bhogini ca śaktipātābhyupagatau atiprasaṅgaḥ īśvarecchānimittatve tu jñānodayasya anyonyāśrayatā vaiyarthyaṃ ca īśvare rāgādiprasaṅgaḥ viruddhayoḥ karmaṇoḥ samabalayoḥ anyonyapratibandhe karmasāmyaṃ tataḥ śaktipāta iti cet na kramikatve virodhāyogāt virodhe 'pi anyasya aviruddhasya karmaṇo bhogadānaprasaṅgāt aviruddhakarmāpravṛttau tadaiva dehapātaprasaṅgāt jātyāyuṣpradaṃ karma na pratibadhyate bhogapradam eva tu pratibadhyate iti cet kutaḥ tatkarmasadbhāve yadi śaktiḥ patet tarhi sā bhogapradāt kiṃ bibhiyāt

plain_english: Now: in impurity-ripening, power-descent — of-what-nature, and its mark? By this the difference-doctrinaires' incoherent counter — dispassion, special-duty, discernment, true-service, true-attainment, god-worship and-rest-as-reason.
sanskrit_cite: atha malaparipāke śaktipātaḥ so 'pi kiṃsvarūpaḥ kiṃ ca tasya nimittam iti etena vairāgyaṃ dharmaviśeṣo vivekaḥ satsevā satprāptiḥ devapūjā ityādihetuḥ pratyukta iti bhedavādināṃ sarvam asamañjasam

plain_english: In the doctrine-of-two-inseparables-of-free-Lord, however, it is sustained: as the Supreme-Lord by self-covering-sport attains cattle-being, individual, atom — no place-time-form-difference-contradiction of him; likewise, by withdrawal-of-self-hiding self-recovery — suddenly or in-order, taking-refuge, the atom is called vessel-of-power-descent. Made-merely-of-freedom this Supreme-Siva is power's causer-to-descend. Thus independent is the power-descent: who[se is] fruit-of-self-manifestation; but who[se] is one-eager-for-enjoyment, he is act-dependent; of one-eager-for-supernatural-enjoyment, he just is power-descent. Qualified-by-maya-womb-inspired-by-Lord's-will, through-door-of-Rudra-Vishnu-Brahma-and-rest, mantra-and-rest-form-ness, maya-puru-distinction, puru-kala, puru-nature, puru-intellect distinctions, and other fruit obtaining — lower-tattva-enjoyment binds. One-eager-for-both: in-enjoyment act-dependent; in-release independent-of-it — thus both-dependent-and-independent.
sanskrit_cite: svatantraparameśādvayavāde tu upapadyate etat yathāhi parameśvaraḥ svarūpācchādanakrīḍayā paśuḥ pudgalo 'ṇuḥ sampannaḥ na ca tasya deśakālasvarūpabhedavirodhaḥ tadvat svarūpasthaganavinivṛttyā svarūpapratyāpattiṃ jhaṭiti vā krameṇa vā samāśrayan śaktipātapātram aṇuḥ ucyate svātantryamātrasāraś ca asau paramaśivaḥ śakteḥ pātayitā iti nirapekṣa eva śaktipāto yaḥ svarūpaprathāphalaḥ yas tu bhogotsukasya sa karmāpekṣaḥ lokottararūpabhogotsukasya tu sa eva śaktipātaḥ parameśvarecchāpreritamāyāgarbhādhikārīyarudraviṣṇubrahmādidvāreṇa mantrādirūpatvaṃ māyāpuṃvivekaṃ puṃskalāvivekaṃ puṃprakṛtivivekaṃ puṃbuddhivivekam anyac ca phalaṃ prasnuvānaḥ tadadharatattvabhogaṃ pratibadhnāti bhogamokṣobhayotsukasya bhoge karmāpekṣo mokṣe tu tannirapekṣaḥ iti sāpekṣanirapekṣaḥ

plain_english: Nor is it to-be-said: in-someone-just man power-descent. He just is the Supreme-Lord — thus shines. In-being-truth: who is this man, by-name — that in-purport object-made-impulse, this.
sanskrit_cite: na ca vācyaṃ kasmāt kasmiṃścid eva puṃsi śaktipāta iti sa eva parameśvaraḥ tathā bhāti iti satattve ko 'sau pumān nāma yaduddeśena viṣayakṛtā codanā iyam

plain_english: And this power-descent ninefold in intense-middle-mild, by-superiority-equality-inferiority; again from-triplicity. Therein: from-superior-intense just-then in-body-death Supremeness; from-middle-intense, one-independent-of-scripture-teacher, of-own-conviction, intuitive-knowledge-arising — in-which-arising outer-consecration without-alone giving-enjoyment-and-release, intuitive teacher, thus said. For his no-conception-of-samayya-and-rest-any, even-herein degree-existence from-wills-manifoldness — thus, being-even in-intuitive-ness, dependence-on-scripture-and-rest would-be for-agreement — even. Thus many-fissures-and-walls-division of-teacher and of-intuitive-one in-scriptures is-said; in-any-case intuitive-part stronger in-its-presence, of-others from-unqualification.
sanskrit_cite: sa cāyaṃ śaktipāto navadhā tīvramadhyamandasya utkarṣamādhyasthyanikarṣaiḥ punas traividhyāt tatra utkṛṣṭatīvrāt tadaiva dehapāte parameśatā madhyatīvrāt śāstrācāryānapekṣiṇaḥ svapratyayasya prātibhajñānodayaḥ yadudaye bāhyasaṃskāraṃ vinaiva bhogāpavargapradaḥ prātibho gurur ity ucyate tasya hi na samayyādikalpanā kācit atrāpi tāratamyasadbhāvaḥ icchāvaicitryāt iti saty api prātibhatve śāstrādyapekṣā saṃvādāya syād api iti nirbhittisabhittyādibahubhedatvam ācāryasya prātibhasyāgameṣu uktam sarvathā pratibhāṃśo balīyān tatsaṃnidhau anyeṣām anadhikārāt

plain_english: As difference-view, as in-presence-of-eternal-Siva of-liberated-Sivas in-creation-dissolution-and-rest-functions: from-mild-intense power-descent, good-guru-subject wish-to-be-attained becomes; in-bad-guru-subject, concealment just; from-bad-guru-ness, good-guru-approach from-power-descent indeed.
sanskrit_cite: bhedadarśana iva anādiśivasaṃnidhau muktaśivānāṃ sṛṣṭilayādikṛtyeṣu mandatīvrāt śaktipātāt sadguruviṣayā yiyāsā bhavati asadguruviṣayāyāṃ tu tirobhāva eva asadgurutas tu sadgurugamanaṃ śaktipātād eva

plain_english: Good-guru is full-of-all-this-scripture-truth-knowledge, directly Bhagavan-Bhairava-Bhattacharya — indeed of-yogis-even by-own-studied-knowledge in-freeness-giving; therein of-qualifiability like-good-fortune-beauty-and-rest-possession from-non-application.
sanskrit_cite: sadgurus tu samastaitacchāstratattvajñānapūrṇaḥ sākṣāt bhagavadbhairavabhaṭṭāraka eva yogino 'pi svabhyastajñānatayaiva mocakatve tatra yogyatvasya saubhāgyalāvaṇyādimattvasyevānupayogāt

plain_english: Bad-guru is other — all just.
sanskrit_cite: asadgurus tu anyaḥ sarva eva

plain_english: Thus-wisher's of-guru knowledge-named initiation obtains, by-which at-once freed becomes, living-even herein: from-seeing, from-telling, from-scripture-teaching, from-conduct-showing, from-charity-giving and-rest kinds.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yiyāsuḥ guroḥ jñānalakṣaṇāṃ dīkṣāṃ prāpnoti yayā sadya eva mukto bhavati jīvann api atra avalokanāt kathanāt śāstrasambodhanāt caryādarśanāt carudānāt ityādayo bhedāḥ

plain_english: Of-practitioner or just-then at-once life-releasing initiation obtains; she but in-death-moment-alone to-be-done — thus we-shall-tell-thus.
sanskrit_cite: abhyāsavato vā tadānīṃ sadya eva prāṇaviyojikāṃ dīkṣāṃ labhate sā tu maraṇakṣaṇa eva kāryā iti vakṣyāma iti

plain_english: Intense threefold from-superior-middle power-descent: even-though-initiated, of-own-self in-Siva-ness not so firm-conviction becomes; by-ripening-order-of-conviction but at-body's-end Siva just. From-middle-intense but eager-for-Siva-ness even enjoyment-seeking becomes — thus just-so in-initiation vessel-of-knowledge, he and gained-by-yoga-practice by-this-alone by-body enjoyment-having at-body's-end Siva just.
sanskrit_cite: tīvrās tridhā utkṛṣṭamadhyāt śaktipātāt kṛtadīkṣāko 'pi svātmanaḥ śivatāyāṃ na tathā dṛḍhapratipattiḥ bhavati pratipattiparipākakrameṇa tu dehānte śiva eva madhyamadhyāt tu śivatotsuko 'pi bhogaprepsuḥ bhavati iti tathaiva dīkṣāyāṃ jñānabhājanam sa ca yogābhyāsalabdham anenaiva dehena bhogaṃ bhuktvā dehānte śiva eva

plain_english: From-inferior-middle but by-another-body enjoyment-having Siva-hood attains — thus.
sanskrit_cite: nikṛṣṭamadhyāt tu dehāntareṇa bhogaṃ bhuktvā śivatvam eti iti

plain_english: Middle but threefold enjoyment-eagerness: when become-primary, then mildness by-Lord-mantra-yoga-means — since therein eagerness of-Lord-mantra-yoga-and-rest, since ending-in-release — therefore power-descent-nature.
sanskrit_cite: madhyas tu tridhā bhogotsukatā yadā pradhānabhūtā tadā mandatvaṃ pārameśvaramantrayogopāyatayā yatas tatra autsukyam pārameśamantrayogādeś ca yato mokṣaparyantatvam ataḥ śaktipātarūpatā

plain_english: Even-therein from-degree triplicity — thus this chief power-descent.
sanskrit_cite: tatrāpi tāratamyāt traividhyam ity eṣa mukhyaḥ śaktipātaḥ

plain_english: Of-Vaishnavas-and-rest but like-king's-grace not ending-in-release — thus no distinction herein.
sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādīnāṃ tu rājānugrahavat na mokṣāntatā iti na iha vivecanam

plain_english: Siva-Power-abode but everywhere — said. She most-supreme is not, but fierce, fiercer or — this power-descent manifold even from-degree-manifoldness is-differentiated: some standing-in-Vaishnavas-and-rest by-samayya-and-rest-order in-five-streams attained-ripening supreme-authority-in-six-and-a-half-scriptures attains; other but by-transgression-order by-infinite-difference some non-sequential — thus. Therefore standing-in-lower-higher-doctrine teachers even herein in-mere-mandala-seeing even unqualified; standing-in-higher-doctrine but teacher lower-higher-doctrine on-the-contrary approves from-fullness — thus qualified-for-all.
sanskrit_cite: śivaśaktyadhiṣṭhānaṃ tu sarvatra iti uktam sā paraṃ jyeṣṭhā na bhavati api tu ghorā ghoratarā vā sa eṣa śaktipāto vicitro 'pi tāratamyavaicitryāt bhidyate kaścid vaiṣṇavādisthaḥ samayyādikrameṇa srotaḥpañcake ca prāptaparipākaḥ sarvottīrṇabhagavatṣaḍardhaśāstraparamādhikāritām eti anyas tu ullaṅghanakrameṇa anantabhedena ko 'pi akramam iti ata eva adharādharaśāsanasthā guravo 'pi iha maṇḍalamātradarśane 'pi anadhikāriṇaḥ ūrdhvaśāsanasthas tu guruḥ adharādharaśāsanaṃ pratyuta prāṇayati pūrṇatvāt iti sarvādhikārī

sanskrit_cite: sa ca daiśiko guruḥ ācāryo dīkṣakaḥ cumbakaḥ sa cāyaṃ pūrṇajñāna eva sarvottamaḥ tena vinā dīkṣādyasampatteḥ

sanskrit_cite: yogī tu phalotsukasya yukto yadi upāyopadeśena avyavahitam eva phalaṃ dātuṃ śaktaḥ upāyopadeśena tu jñāne eva yukto mokṣe 'pi abhyupāyāt jñānapūrṇatākāṅkṣī ca bahūn api gurūn kuryāt

sanskrit_cite: nanu so 'pi abruvan viparītaṃ vā bruvan kiṃ na tyājyaḥ naiva iti brūmaḥ tasya hi pūrṇajñānatvāt eva rāgādyabhāva iti avacanādikaṃ śiṣyagatenaiva kenacit ayogyatvānāśvastatvādinā nimittena syāt iti tadupāsane yatanīyaṃ śiṣyeṇa na tattyāge

Likewise his awakened-behavior she but being-condemned from-being-forbidden-conduct-form oneself and by-it-alone from-self-suspicion him in-mire-of-sorrow-delusion he-drowns. Not but of-arisen-power-descent concealment-even exists herein even and dependence-on-act-and-rest as-before having-prohibited; therein even from-wills-manifoldness this body-only-enjoyment-sorrow-fruit-ness or in-initiation-covenant-conduct-teacher-god-fire-and-rest of-servicing-condemning-both-engaged like before of-Siva-doctrine-standers of-abandoning-him like.
